Wait 4π × 10^-7 * 12.5 = 50π × 10^-7? Because 4π * 12.5 = 50π. So B = 50π × 10^-7 = 5π × 10^-6? Actually 50π × 10^-7 = 5π × 10^-6. So B = 5π × 10^-6 T. π ≈ 3.14159, so 5π ≈ 15.70795. So B ≈ 15.70795 × 10^-6 T = 1.570795 × 10^-5 T. So about 1.57 × 10^-5 Tesla.
